en.name: Gangster
en.ability: Once per day, you may choose to kill an alive neighbour, if your other alive neighbour agrees.
en.flavor: I like your shoes. It would be such a shame if you had a little accident, and they got ruined. Now that you mention it, I like your cufflinks too.

zh.name: 黑帮
